title: Homework in the Library
setting: A quiet school library with wooden desks and many books.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna, a young girl with long black hair and a red shirt

sentences.en: At four o'clock, two students enter the library.
sentences.zh: 四点钟，两个学生走进图书馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater and Anna, a young girl with long black hair and a red shirt with school bags walk into a quiet library, a wall clock above the door.

sentences.en: Ben and Anna sit at a big desk.
sentences.zh: 本和安娜坐在一张大书桌旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater and Anna, a young girl with long black hair and a red shirt sit side by side at a big wooden desk with books.

sentences.en: Anna does her French reading first.
sentences.zh: 安娜先做她的法语阅读。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a young girl with long black hair and a red shirt reads a book with a small French flag on the cover.

sentences.en: Ben practises his English writing in a notebook.
sentences.zh: 本在笔记本上练习英语写作。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater writes carefully in a notebook next to an English textbook.

sentences.en: He writes each new word again and again.
sentences.zh: 他把每个新单词写了一遍又一遍。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater copies the same short word many times down a page.

sentences.en: Grammar is hard, and maths is even harder.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater frowns at a grammar book and a maths book with a pencil in his mouth.

sentences.en: Anna checks his answers, and they are correct.
sentences.zh: 安娜检查了他的答案，都是对的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a young girl with long black hair and a red shirt looks at Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater's notebook and makes green tick marks.

sentences.en: Ben cannot believe it and smiles at Anna.
sentences.zh: 本简直不敢相信，冲着安娜笑了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater looks surprised and happy and smiles at Anna, a young girl with long black hair and a red shirt.
